Current reread confirms that F1 uses only the unchanged statement that {H_5, co-E} has the Erdos-Hajnal property. The repaired lemma proves that exact source Lemma 6.3 conclusion by the H_0-to-H_5 leaf induction using Huang--Ju--Zhou Corollary 1.8; together with the unchanged special-vertex structural theorem, it still supplies the common constant and local partition required by the property-(*) criterion.

The impact is transitive through the structural theorem, but the example does not use the changed Erdos-Hajnal lemma. Its current proof directly checks the partition: the displayed graph is bipartite while co-E contains a triangle; each four-vertex B_i licenses the singleton choice; Y_i is independent and therefore H_5-free as well as co-E-free; and all cross-block vertices are anticomplete to each singleton X_i.

Although the changed lemma remains in deps, it is not a premise of this structural theorem: F1--F3 and proof steps 1.1--2.1 use only overlap-quotient termination, terminal-pattern freeness, external purity, and the graph/free-family definitions. The nonempty branch and the empty X_i^0 singleton branch establish the source Lemma 6.4 partition without invoking an Erdos-Hajnal constant, so the lemma's repaired citation carrier cannot affect this claim.
